metadata.question: Did the Jianghan District of Wuhan show lower nightime light intensity on February 4, 2020, compared to January 19, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about nighttime light intensity in Jianghan District, Wuhan on two specific dates (February 4, 2020 vs January 19, 2020). This requires: 1. Data: VIIRS Day/Night Band (DNB) data for nighttime lights from the Suomi NPP or NOAA-20 satellites 2. Location: Jianghan District, Wuhan, China - I'll use a point or polygon around the district center 3. Dates: Two specific dates to compare 4. Processing: Compare the mean radiance values between the two dates For nighttime lights, I should use the VIIRS DNB monthly composites (VNP46A3) rather than daily data, as daily data can be affected by clouds and lunar illumination. However, the question specifically asks for those exact dates, so I'll need to use daily data and handle the limitations. Let me use: - Collection: 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2' (VIIRS/NPP Daily DNB) - Band: 'DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m' - Geometry: Point for Jianghan District (approx 30.58°N, 114.27°E) I need to: 1. Check if images exist for both dates 2. Extract mean radiance values 3. Compare the values 4. Handle cases where data is missing or invalid The key challenge will be cloud cover and data availability for specific dates. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const jianghanDistrict = ee.Geometry.Point([114.27, 30.58]).buffer(2000); // ~2km buffer around district center const date1 = '2020-01-19'; const date2 = '2020-02-04'; // 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Daily DNB for nighttime lights const viirsCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2') .select('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m'); const img1 = viirsCol.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(jianghanDistrict).first(); const img2 = viirsCol.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(jianghanDistrict).first(); // Check data availability const hasImg1 = img1 && ee.Image(img1).bandNames().size().getInfo() > 0; const hasImg2 = img2 && ee.Image(img2).bandNames().size().getInfo() > 0; if (!hasImg1 || !hasImg2) { console.log(`Data status: Jan19=${hasImg1}, Feb4=${hasImg2}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get mean radiance values const scale = 1000; const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true); const stats1 = ee.Image(img1).reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: jianghanDistrict, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = ee.Image(img2).reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: jianghanDistrict, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean1 = stats1.get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m_mean').getInfo(); const count1 = stats1.get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m_count').getInfo(); const mean2 = stats2.get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m_mean').getInfo(); const count2 = stats2.get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m_count').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log(`Valid pixels: Jan19=${count1}, Feb4=${count2}`); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log(`Means: Jan19=${mean1}, Feb4=${mean2}`); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Jan19 mean: ${mean1.toFixed(4)} (pixels: ${count1})`); console.log(`Feb4 mean: ${mean2.toFixed(4)} (pixels: ${count2})`); console.log(`Difference: ${(mean2 - mean1).toFixed(4)}`); // Check if Feb 4 shows lower intensity than Jan 19 if (mean2 < mean1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
